help: Preview, then apply, a recoverable taker-only repair of one stored trade bundle
description: Re-normalize a stored 0xArchive trade bundle from its own raw pages (taker-only fills). Without --apply nothing changes and the counts are reported; --apply moves the original aside to <bundle>.pre_taker_only_v2 and publishes the repaired bundle in its place. A bundle already at the current normalization is reported unchanged. Rebuild the research database afterwards with 'db build --replace-changed'.

options.help: stored trade bundle directory (its name ends in _trades)
publish the repair (default: preview only, nothing changes)
